title: Deng Kuol case should be closed
article: A letter from Lahni Rawlings, Calgary.

Deng Kuol's family believes he was shot and killed because he was Sudanese. That is irrelevant. The only important fact is that a police officer was stabbed while doing his job. He acted in self- defence and shot at the man who stabbed him.
Unfortunately, Kuol died as a result of his wounds. His race or colour has nothing to do with it. I don't deny that racism exists, but it's just not the case in this incident.
Family members said they believed Kuol was innocent. I don't understand their reasoning. He stabbed an officer of the law.
How is that innocent? Kuol's family is asking for an apology. Have they apologized to the police officer for the stab wound he suffered?
The investigation into the incident is enough.
There is no need to spend more taxpayers' money determining that the police officer acted in self-defence.
